note: Product decisions mirror the framework's Decisions Log (§16) and are authoritative there. ADRs cover implementation choices. Open questions are tracked here until they become decisions.

product_decisions.decision: RIASEC retained as internal scaffold only; re-derivation from local data planned.
Telegram Mini App primary consumer surface with full web parity.
No ranked lists or individual score exports, permanently.
B2B beachhead: private schools; public scale via tuman-level deals.
Migration pathway content on consumer surface only.

open_questions.question: Hosting provider inside Uzbekistan that satisfies the data-residency requirement.
Transliteration implementation: build-time or render-time, and who owns the exception table.
The two remaining values cards, to be determined in Phase 0.
Monetization of T-5 family consultations, and what paid mentorship does to the volunteer framing.
Stipend levels and funding source for MS-2 near-peers, and whether university partners co-fund.
Moderation staffing for T-2 at launch scale: in-house or trained senior mentors.
Who moderates T-3 content, and what advisor training adds for hosting duties.
Karakalpak and regional-language mentor supply timing relative to locale expansion.
Legal review of obligations around organized minor-adult contact under Uzbek law. Required before any T-4+ format.
Whether T-2 answers are attributable by full name or first name plus role.
